FAQ

How do I start a project?

Choose a service, fill in the form or message us on WhatsApp, and we will reply to confirm scope, price and timeline.

Do I pay online?

No. This site does not take payments. Pricing is agreed with you directly.

How many revisions are included?

Each service and package lists its revision limit. Extra revisions can be agreed in advance.
